import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds
#check_failure MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv_rename
#check_failure MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv
#check @MvPolynomial.pderiv_rename
#check @MvPolynomial.rename_monomial
#check @MvPolynomial.coeff_rename_mapDomain
#check @Finsupp.prod_mapDomain_index_inj
#check @Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective
#check @Finsupp.mapDomain_tsub
#check @Finsupp.lsum_single
namespace AssessHasseRenameAbstract
open MvPolynomial
variable {σ τ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
theorem natural_monomial (f : σ → τ)
    (D : MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial σ R)
    (E : MvPolynomial τ R →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial τ R)
    (h : ∀ k a, E (monomial (k.mapDomain f) a) = rename f (D (monomial k a)))
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) : E (rename f P) = rename f (D P) := by
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial k a => simpa only [rename_monomial] using h k a
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
#print axioms natural_monomial
end AssessHasseRenameAbstract

@MvPolynomial.pderiv_rename : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {τ : Type u_3} {f : σ → τ},
  Function.Injective f →
    ∀ (x : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
      (MvPolynomial.pderiv (f x)) ((MvPolynomial.rename f) p) = (MvPolynomial.rename f) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv x) p)

@MvPolynomial.coeff_rename_mapDomain : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R]
  (f : σ → τ),
  Function.Injective f →
    ∀ (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ((MvPolynomial.rename f) φ).coeff (Finsupp.mapDomain f d) = φ.coeff d

@Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid M]
  {f : α → β}, Function.Injective f → ∀ (x : α →₀ M) (a : α), (Finsupp.mapDomain f x) (f a) = x a

@Finsupp.mapDomain_tsub : ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid α]
  [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [inst_2 : CanonicallyOrderedAdd α] [inst_3 : Sub α] [inst_4 : OrderedSub α] {f : ι → κ},
  Function.Injective f →
    ∀ (f1 f2 : ι →₀ α), Finsupp.mapDomain f (f1 - f2) = Finsupp.mapDomain f f1 - Finsupp.mapDomain f f2

@Finsupp.lsum_single : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} {R₂ : Type u_5} (S : Type u_6)
  [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring R₂] [inst_2 : Semiring S] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_4 : Module R M]
  [inst_5 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_6 : Module R₂ N] {σ : R →+* R₂} [inst_7 : Module S N] [inst_8 : SMulCommClass R₂ S N]
  (f : α → M →ₛₗ[σ] N) (i : α) (m : M), ((Finsupp.lsum S) f) (Finsupp.single i m) = (f i) m
